Summary

Background built on shipped dashboards, not just theory.

I'm a Power BI Developer and Data Analyst with over three years of experience across Business Intelligence, ETL, SQL data modeling, and dashboard development. My work has ranged from securing financial project data with Row-Level Security on engineering workstreams in Riyadh, to closing a 15% inventory shrinkage gap in retail operations back in India.

Outside of work, I build dashboards on real-world datasets to keep sharpening the craft — from workforce attendance and HR attrition to retail outlet performance — covering everything from Power Query cleanup to DAX-driven KPI storytelling. You'll find a handful of these in the gallery below.

I care about dashboards that survive contact with real stakeholders — models that stay fast at scale, DAX that's readable six months later, and reports people actually open every morning. Currently deepening this with the Microsoft PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst Associate) certification.
